propertyNames.$comment: A namespace Prefix is an XML NCName [NAMESPACES], not an ACAL IdentifierType - it has no {ShortId} macro-substitution concept, and its lexical space is narrower. This pattern is an ASCII-practical approximation of NCName, in the same spirit as IdentifierType's own documented looseness (see that $def's $comment) but for a different, narrower grammar; 'xmlns' is excluded because [NAMESPACES] reserves it and never permits it as a prefix. The empty string key is the separate, valid default-namespace declaration.

NamespaceMapType.$comment: Maps each namespace Prefix (the empty string denotes the default namespace) directly to its Name (URI), rather than an array of {Prefix, Name} pair-objects, per issue #134. A producer SHALL NOT emit a duplicate key; a consumer SHALL reject one. JSON Schema cannot enforce this, since a validator only sees the instance after parsing, by which point a duplicate key has already been resolved in an implementation-defined way (RFC 8259) - see acal-xpath-v1.0.md Section 5.2 for the normative producer/consumer requirement.
